# JSON Byte

> JSON Byte is a free, open-source browser tool for visualizing and comparing JSON and YAML documents. All document processing happens locally in the user's browser.

## Tools

- [JSON and YAML Graph Visualizer](https://json-byte.pages.dev/): Explore nested objects and arrays as an interactive graph, synchronize selections with the source editor, and search by keyword or JSONPath.
- [JSON and YAML Diff Viewer](https://json-byte.pages.dev/diff/): Compare two JSON or YAML documents side by side, format them, filter unchanged lines, and configure surrounding context.

## Key facts

- Supported input: JSON, JSON with comments, YAML, and multi-document YAML.
- Privacy: Input documents are processed locally and are not uploaded to JSON Byte servers.
- Access: The web tools are free and do not require an account.
- License: Apache License 2.0.
- Source: https://github.com/imjuni/json-byte
- Publisher: RovinjSoft, https://rovinjsoft.com/
